method.name: Mann-Kendall trend test on yearly values
method.description: Yearly values: each cell's monthly values are combined into one value per year (sum of its 12 months), keeping only years with all 12 months, so the seasonal cycle does not enter the test. Period tested: 2001-2025. A cell is tested only with at least 20 of 25 complete years (566 cells tested). The trend is the Mann-Kendall test on those yearly values (original Mann-Kendall test (no autocorrelation correction needed); 7% of the tested cells show residual autocorrelation) and its size is Sen's slope (median of the slopes between all pairs of years) times 10, in % of cell per year per decade. Because hundreds of cells are tested at once, the p-values are corrected with the Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate across all tested cells of this variable; a cell is significant when its adjusted q-value is below 0.05. The pValue shown is the raw p-value of the test, not q.  Generated by the SIGNO pipeline (pipeline/), code written with Claude (Anthropic) via Claude Code following the team's choices; values come only from the cited NASA and Hansen/UMD datasets.
